description: Baseline metric reproduction for SpillSense oil spill pipeline

segmenter_curated_patches.note: Curated-patch Dice=0.828 vs full-scene macro Dice~0.68: difference driven by extreme class imbalance (~1:200 fg:bg) across full 2048x2048 scenes. Validation patches are oversampled 4x oil to reduce gap during training.

metric_domain_clarification.cls_val: 4,818 patches from 217 held-out validation scenes (v3 Zenodo dataset). Evaluated with best_dualpol_classifier.pt (threshold=0.490). Most reliable classifier metric — genuinely held-out.
metric_domain_clarification.seg_patch: Curated 512x512 oil-containing patches from Zenodo train/val scenes. Dice=0.828 reflects in-distribution patches with 4x oil oversampling. Not comparable to full-scene Dice.
metric_domain_clarification.seg_full_scene: Full 2048x2048 scene tiled inference with 512x512/384 stride. Macro Dice~0.68 due to ~1:200 fg:bg class imbalance. Open-ocean speckle accumulates false positives, reducing precision to ~64-67%.
metric_domain_clarification.gallery: 40 benchmark patches from 4 scene categories. Uses best_classifier_v3.pt gallery-tuned model (threshold=0.10). NOT a held-out set — model was tuned to these scenes.
